import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_69/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_69/test_1.csv"
    source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_69/test_2.csv"

    # Load source tables
    df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)  # Columns: user_id, year_school, floor
    df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)  # Columns: user_id, party, libcon
    df2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path)  # Columns: user_id, fav_music

    # Ensure user_id columns are integer type for consistent joins
    df0['user_id'] = df0['user_id'].astype(int)
    df1['user_id'] = df1['user_id'].astype(int)
    df2['user_id'] = df2['user_id'].astype(int)

    # Merge source tables on user_id
    # Step 1: Merge df0 and df1 (left join to keep all user_ids from df0)
    merged_01 = pd.merge(df0, df1, on='user_id', how='left')

    # Step 2: Merge the result with df2 (left join to keep all user_ids from merged_01)
    merged_all = pd.merge(merged_01, df2, on='user_id', how='left')

    # Select and reorder columns to match target schema
    # Target schema: ['user_id': int, 'year_school': str, 'floor': str, 'party': str, 'libcon': str, 'fav_music': str]
    target_columns = ['user_id', 'year_school', 'floor', 'party', 'libcon', 'fav_music']
    target_df = merged_all[target_columns]

    # Convert data types explicitly
    target_df['user_id'] = target_df['user_id'].astype(int)
    target_df['year_school'] = target_df['year_school'].astype(str)
    target_df['floor'] = target_df['floor'].astype(str)
    target_df['party'] = target_df['party'].astype(str)
    target_df['libcon'] = target_df['libcon'].astype(str)
    target_df['fav_music'] = target_df['fav_music'].astype(str)

    # Write the result to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_69/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
